normalization: none; native attention head scaling retained in C
weighting: each recorded observation equally weighted within token; each competitor identity equally weighted; each of 48252 targets equally weighted; model summaries equal path means
heatmap_context: independent repeated-sequence scan, average over seven prefix lengths; displayed intensity is probe attention, not margin

definitions.mean_abs_b: Take |b_ij| before the same target/competitor averaging; complete eigenvalue-weighted Hplus. Model averages give each reported path equal weight.

absolute_statistics.signed_identity: m = G - b + T uses signed b and T; mean |b| is a magnitude summary and is not substituted into this identity.
